phase: the loader channel: built, run, and a measurement error found
result: the kernel is healthy; the 'crashes' were adb failures

the_measurement_error.what_i_did: after each flash I waited up to 200 seconds for adb, and when adb did not appear I recorded it as a hang
the_measurement_error.what_actually_happened: the operator reported that they had not touched the phone and it was back in Android. The HLOG confirms it: 6667 lines, 438 seconds, iOS home screen drawing at 10 fps, return-gate state=2 allowed=1
the_measurement_error.why_it_matters: that turned a healthy boot into a failure, and it means an unknown number of the 'hangs' counted this session were adb not attaching rather than the kernel stopping. The count of 'twelve restores' is therefore not a count of twelve hangs.
the_measurement_error.what_was_missing: a check of whether the phone is alive at all -- USB presence, the loader's own screen output -- before calling a boot a failure
the_measurement_error.hw_to_avoid_it: look for the device on USB and read the screen, and give adb longer than two minutes; a phone drawing its home screen is not hung

what_was_built.the_loader_channel_was_mostly_there: loader-src/xnuloader/loader.c already had struct loader_block version 3, block_start(), block_poll() in the main loop, and the ufs_shared_pa= argument; the only thing missing was boot-arg ufs=2, which gates all of it
what_was_built.kernel_side: bsd/dev/hakios.ufs.c and hakios.ufshc.c were optional and never built; they were made standard for one round, and the empty versions in hakios.stubs.c were turned off. That linked and booted.
what_was_built.the_test: user-test/xnusys_ufsdev.c opens /dev/ufs_xnusys and reads the window's first and last blocks; it never touches the lease because the kernel hands the request to the loader
what_was_built.where_it_stands: the three-cell experiment was run with the ufs=2 gate toggled and the kernel driver toggled, but every cell was scored by whether adb came back within 200 s -- which is the measurement that turned out to be wrong. None of the three results can be trusted.

what_is_known_to_be_true: a kernel with window_read in it boots, runs 438 seconds, and returns with the lease RESTORED
an empty rc never exercises any read, so that says nothing about the read path
the loader has a complete request/answer protocol that the kernel never used on this phone
what_must_be_redone: the three-cell experiment, scored by the HLOG and the screen rather than by adb
a read test with ufs=2 on, checked the same way

phone.note: boot_a currently holds build ba12af84, the ufs=2 / hakios.ufs build. Stock restore is a single fastboot flash and has been done many times this session; it was not done before this turn ended because the operator asked for the log and the push.
